locations.name: North Palm Beach
locations.intro: Hector's first location, on US Highway 1 since the beginning. Hand-washed inside and out by trained staff. Five tiers, walk-in service, no appointment needed.
locations.neighborhoodsCopy: Customers drive in from Palm Beach Gardens, Lake Park, Juno Beach, and the islands. Lost Tree Village and Old Port Cove regulars know the routine.

locations.name: Jupiter
locations.intro: The express wash with hands on it. Every car gets the wheels and rims prepped by staff before the conveyor. Every car gets checked at the dry-off, not just blown and waved through. Single washes or unlimited monthly memberships.
locations.neighborhoodsCopy: The Jupiter shop is the daily-driver shop. Members from Abacoa and Tequesta come twice a week. Snowbirds from Jupiter Inlet Colony stop in on the way home from the marina.

locations.name: Riviera Beach
locations.intro: The newest Hector's, on Broadway in Riviera Beach. Same hand-wash service as North Palm Beach — same staff training, same five tiers, same standards.
locations.neighborhoodsCopy: Convenient for Singer Island residents and West Palm Beach commuters. Right on the corridor heading to the marina and Port of Palm Beach.
